destinations.name: Eiffel Tower
destinations.description: Iconic wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. Built in 1889, it's one of the world's most recognizable landmarks.
destinations.travelTips: Visit early morning or late evening to avoid crowds. Book tickets online to skip the line.

destinations.name: Machu Picchu
destinations.description: 15th-century Inca citadel located in southern Peru on a mountain ridge above the Sacred Valley. It's renowned for its sophisticated dry-stone walls and panoramic views.
destinations.travelTips: Buy entrance tickets well in advance. Consider hiring a guide to learn the history of this ancient site.

destinations.name: Great Barrier Reef
destinations.description: World's largest coral reef system composed of over 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands stretching for over 2,300 kilometers off the coast of Queensland, Australia.
destinations.travelTips: The best way to experience the reef is through snorkeling or diving tours from Cairns or Port Douglas.

destinations.name: Mount Fuji
destinations.description: Japan's tallest peak and an active volcano that last erupted in 1707. It's considered sacred and has inspired artists and poets for centuries.
destinations.travelTips: Climbing season is July to September. For the best views, visit the Chureito Pagoda or Lake Kawaguchiko.

metadata.bestTimeToVisit: July-September for climbing, November-February for views

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.description: Steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. It's one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World and reveals billions of years of geological history.
destinations.travelTips: The South Rim is open year-round and offers the best viewpoints. Consider hiking below the rim for a more immersive experience.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.description: Stunning Greek island in the Aegean Sea known for its white-washed buildings with blue domes, dramatic cliffs, and spectacular sunsets.
destinations.travelTips: Visit in shoulder season (April-May or September-October) to avoid crowds. Don't miss the sunset in Oia.

destinations.name: Taj Mahal
destinations.description: Ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river in the Indian city of Agra. It was commissioned in 1632 by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan to house the tomb of his favorite wife.
destinations.travelTips: Visit at sunrise to avoid crowds and capture the best photos. Closed on Fridays.

destinations.name: Serengeti National Park
destinations.description: Tanzania's oldest and most popular national park, famous for its annual migration of over 1.5 million wildebeest and 250,000 zebra.
destinations.travelTips: The best time to witness the wildebeest migration is June to August. Book safaris well in advance.

destinations.name: Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis)
destinations.description: Natural light display in the Earth's sky, predominantly seen in high-latitude regions. This location in Abisko, Sweden is one of the best places to view them.
destinations.travelTips: Visit between September and March for the best chance to see the lights. Allow at least 3 nights to increase your chances.

destinations.name: Great Wall of China
destinations.description: Ancient fortification system built across the historical northern borders of China to protect against invasions. This coordinate points to the restored Mutianyu section.
destinations.travelTips: Mutianyu is less crowded than Badaling. Take the cable car up and toboggan down for a fun experience.

destinations.name: Bora Bora
destinations.description: Small South Pacific island northwest of Tahiti in French Polynesia, known for its turquoise lagoon, overwater bungalows, and luxurious resorts.
destinations.travelTips: Save by booking a garden bungalow and enjoying the same beaches and activities as those in overwater bungalows.

destinations.name: Petra
destinations.description: Ancient city carved into rose-colored rock faces, dating to around 300 B.C. Famous for its elaborate tomb facades and water conduit system.
destinations.travelTips: Arrive early to avoid crowds and heat. Consider the 'Petra by Night' experience to see the Treasury lit by candlelight.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.description: Built on more than 100 small islands in a lagoon in the Adriatic Sea, Venice has no roads, just canals – including the Grand Canal – lined with Renaissance and Gothic palaces.
destinations.travelTips: Explore the less touristy neighborhoods like Cannaregio and Dorsoduro. Consider a vaporetto pass for unlimited water bus travel.

destinations.name: Angkor Wat
destinations.description: Enormous Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia, built in the first half of the 12th century. The largest religious monument in the world.
destinations.travelTips: Purchase a multi-day pass to explore at a relaxed pace. Hire a knowledgeable guide to understand the history and symbolism.

destinations.name: Maasai Mara
destinations.description: Large game reserve in Kenya famous for its exceptional population of big cats and the annual migration of zebra, wildebeest, and Thomson's gazelle from the Serengeti.
destinations.travelTips: Visit between July and October to witness the Great Migration. Stay in a conservancy for a more exclusive safari experience.

destinations.name: Rio de Janeiro
destinations.description: Brazilian coastal city famous for its Copacabana beach, Christ the Redeemer statue, and vibrant carnival celebrations.
image_queries: Rio de Janeiro Christ the Redeemer
destinations.travelTips: Visit Christ the Redeemer early in the morning to avoid crowds. For Carnival, book accommodations months in advance.
